name: Scheduler
description: Schedule recurring Claude Code tasks with cron expressions
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill** and **7 commands**.

- **Skills** (1): `scheduler` (Schedules Claude Code tasks to run automatically at specific times using native OS schedulers (launchd on macOS, crontab…)
- **Commands** (7): `schedule-add` (Create a new scheduled task for recurring Claude Code execution (project)), `schedule-history` (View execution history for all scheduled tasks with interactive selection), `schedule-list` (List all scheduled tasks with their status and next run times (project)), `schedule-logs` (View execution logs for scheduled tasks), `schedule-remove` (Remove a scheduled task by ID or name), `schedule-run` (Manually run a scheduled task immediately), `schedule-status` (Check the health and status of the scheduler system)

Installs with `claude plugin install scheduler@claude-community` from `jshchnz/claude-code-scheduler`.
